newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Barco jumps on '96 earnings prospects.
newsitem.headline: Barco jumps on '96 earnings prospects.

text.p: Shares in Belgian electronics group Barco NV jumped four percent on Wednesday as investors picked up the stock on expectations Barco's 1996 earnings would show strong growth.
By 1205 GMT the share was up 3.99 percent at 5,740 francs, after earlier touching 5,750 francs, with a modest volume of the share traded worth 91 million Belgian francs.
Analysts forecast current net profit for Barco of between 2.7 and 2.9 billion francs for 1996/97, up around 31 percent from 2.133 billion in 1995/96.
Barco's 1996 results are due out after bourse close.
